name: Sakuraba Zen'ichi
source:
The protagonist of the game who lives together with his little sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c10463]Minaho[/url]. Their parents left overseas to go teach different kinds of people, as they are teachers. He often leaves the making of the breakfast for his childhood friend, [url=https://vndb.org/c10464]Hami[/url]. He is often called an old man due to his tastes: he enjoys tinkering with bonsai trees, and his favorite food is rice crackers. He is good at history while he hates and is bad at english.

Under a request, Zenichi was chosen to be the lone member of the "Lovely Smile Committee" to differentiate between "pure" and "impure" love. However, he soon manages to pull in Hami, [url=https://vndb.org/c10466]Aino[/url], Minaho, [url=https://vndb.org/c10467]Iroha[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c10468]Ayaka[/url] to assist him with the committee work.
